prompt: The scene is rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, capturing the gritty atmosphere of a shipyard dock. On the far left, a rusted anchor chain lies coiled heavily on the wet planks. Next to it stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, looking down at the water. In the center foreground, a wooden crate sits slightly ajar, revealing packing straw inside. A young apprentice in blue overalls points at the crate while speaking to an older foreman in a grey vest who stands beside him. To their right, a brown dog sleeps peacefully on a stack of ropes. Behind the dog, a large cargo ship looms with its hull painted faded red. A seagull perches on the ship's railing, watching the activity below. Near the water's edge on the right, a fisherman in a green raincoat casts a line into the dark harbor. A small rowboat bobs gently next to the fisherman, tethered by a thin rope. In the background, a stack of steel beams rises vertically against the sky. A woman in a white blouse walks past the beams, carrying a rolled-up blueprint. She looks toward a mechanic in dirty coveralls who is wiping grease from his hands with a rag. The mechanic stands next to a large diesel engine block resting on pallets. A black cat sits atop the engine block, observing the mechanic with bright eyes. The foreman gestures toward the crane operator, signaling for attention. The apprentice picks up a wrench from the ground near the crate. The fisherman glances back at the sleeping dog. The woman in the white blouse pauses near the steel beams. There is no digital screen visible anywhere in the yard. There is no modern vehicle parked on the docks.
